stages.purpose: Synthesize new failing cases (output is DATA, not a verdict).
Measure: run analyzers, emit per-case numbers. No pass/fail judgement.
Screen: join numbers to labels, test which signals track failure, correct for multiplicity.
Explain: propose falsifiable mechanism hypotheses, each with a routable test_design.
Adjudicate: statistical gate AND protocol-consistency gate. Both, or not SUPPORTED.
Intervene: change one variable, re-run, read as causal evidence. Does not repair.
Repair: propose candidates, validate paired against the unmodified baseline.
